transcript.text: Good morning. I'm Maj. Alvarez, the Battalion S-6. I'll be publishing the binding network access plan once the change-control board gets the service requirements from operations, logistics, and medical. To get us started, I need each of you to confirm your service requirement and any constraints on segment or time window. We have three segments — Red, Blue, and Green — and three windows: 0800-0900, 1000-1100, and 1400-1500. Also remember, each service must have a documented configuration control before its access window begins, so let's make sure we're tracking that early.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to put a constraint on the table right away. The command video brief must use Segment Green and the 1400-1500 window. I received confirmation this morning that the partner headquarters bridge is configured only for that segment and time. This isn't on the change-control board slide yet, but it's a hard requirement.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to put my constraint on the table as well. The logistics synchronization feed must use Segment Blue and the 1000-1100 window. I confirmed today with the depot technician that the legacy terminal only accepts the Blue segment profile, and the depot upload begins at 1000. This hasn't been added to the network request yet, but it's a hard requirement.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to put my constraint on the table as well. The clinic records system must use Segment Red and the 0800-0900 window. I received the clinic server's isolation certificate record this morning from the clinic administrator — the certificate is valid only on Segment Red, and the morning patient-file reconciliation starts at 0800. This hasn't been entered in the access worksheet yet, but it's a hard requirement.
transcript.speaker: A4
